art_direction.identity: Software-company clarity applied to the trades: white canvas, near-black ink, black primary CTA, hairline dividers, one huge tight headline, floating white dispatch cards over warm photography.
art_direction.type: Inter only. Display weight 600 with tight tracking; body 1rem with relaxed line-height; numbers tabular.
art_direction.color: Ink-on-white with two brand colors: bg-accent (deep pine green) is the PRIMARY — reserved for CTAs and the closing band; text-secondary (warm copper) is the SECONDARY — reserved for rating stars, the trust-pill icon, and step labels. Green (ok) only on the dispatch card's availability dot. Never add a third color.
art_direction.signature: The floating dispatch card — the small white scheduling card in the hero, reprised in the closing band. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Plain-spoken and confident. Short sentences. No fluff, no exclamation points, no jargon.
